test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My uncle‘s legal ________ is his son.
solution:
The correct answer is: **heir**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **heir **is a person who is legally entitled to inherit the property, wealth, or title of another person, typically a family member, upon their death. (उत्तराधिकार में पानेवाला)

 
 
• **Example**: *As the only son of a wealthy business magnate, Daniel was the heir to the family fortune and business empire.*<
